intro: Fill this in at the site visit. Every number feeds the bathroom ballpark in JobTread, which prices Good, Better and Best at once. Write 0 when something does not apply; do not leave it blank.
screen: A structural wall is removed or opened
A plumbing fixture moves to a new location (drain or supply moves)
New foundation, footing or roof tie-in
HVAC extended or relocated beyond a register move
Cabinet layout or the room footprint changes
sections: Wall to wall, the whole bathroom. Include a closet only if it is being remodeled.
Whole room to studs = 1. Shower or tub area only = 0.
Walls framed, removed or relocated. Count each wall.

Tub and surround replaced as a tub/shower combo.
Size and type today, e.g. "60 in tub, fiberglass". For the estimator; not a formula input.
Count the shower valve, each sink and the toilet when each stays where it is.

All new flooring, including any past the bathroom door.
